The current leader is a simple mean on a small subset (pool6), but given the high ranking instability (tau=0.212) and the trend-dominated regime, I want to test if a more robust technique like DBA (Dynamic Bassoni Averaging) on that same high-performing subset can better capture the underlying trend.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8398. Series context: trend strength 0.9261 and seasonal strength 0.3514; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.212); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.712.
